hints.title: Key Insight and Observation
hints.text: A sixteen digit representation maps directly into a four by four grid positions in fixed row-major sequence.

hints.title: Algorithmic Strategy and State
hints.text: The directed traversal identifies seven specific digit positions that must remain monotonically non-decreasing.

hints.title: Optimal Boundary and Processing
hints.text: Digit dynamic programming counts valid configurations bounded by prefix tightness.

hints.title: Complete Implementation

complexity.notes: Fixed sixteen digit grid traversal evaluates in constant bounded states.
complexity.whyNaiveFails: Enumerating all numbers in large numerical intervals causes time limit exceeded.
complexity.spaceTimeTradeoff: Memoizes digit DP states indexed by position, boundary tightness, and path value.
complexity.interviewerExpectation: Applies digit DP over the fixed grid path positions.
